title: Generalist-Specialist Mixture-of-Experts for Rare Pathology Detection in Multimodal Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2609.18688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI models for multimodal medical imaging must balance modality-specific specialization with cross-modal shared representations, a trade-off that pure Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures currently fail to satisfy. Expert-based routing improves in-domain learning but may sacrifice cross-modal signals, which appear particularly important for rare (low-prevalence) pathologies in our experiments. To resolve this, we introduce Generalist-Specialist-MoE (GS-MoE), a two-branch (MoE) architecture that couples a cross-modal generalist model with distinct modality-specific specialists (experts) via domain-constrained feature fusion. On RadImageNet (1.35M images, 165 pathologies, three modalities), GS-MoE recovers detection of six low-prevalence pathologies on which every baseline scores F1 $=$ 0, with per-class gains up to +0.60 F1. translated_title: 用于多模态影像中罕见病理检测的通才-专家混合专家模型
translated_abstract: 面向多模态医学影像的AI模型必须在模态特定专业化与跨模态共享表征之间取得平衡，而当前的纯混合专家架构无法满足这一权衡需求。基于专家的路由虽然能改善域内学习，但可能牺牲跨模态信号，而我们的实验表明跨模态信号对罕见（低患病率）病理尤为重要。为解决这一问题，我们提出了通才-专家混合专家模型（GS-MoE），这是一种双分支MoE架构，通过域约束特征融合将跨模态通才模型与独立的模态特定专家相结合。在RadImageNet数据集（135万张图像、165种病理、三种模态）上，GS-MoE成功恢复了对六种低患病率病理的检测能力——所有基线模型在这些病理上的F1分数均为0，其中单类别F1增益最高达+0.60，同时其整体聚合性能（MCC 0.770）甚至略微超过稠密模型和仅专家MoE基线。
tldr: GS-MoE通过将跨模态通才模型与模态特定专家相结合的双分支混合专家架构，成功检测出所有基线模型均无法识别的六种罕见病理，同时在整体性能上不逊于现有最优方法。
en_tdlr: GS-MoE, a two-branch mixture-of-experts architecture coupling a cross-modal generalist with modality-specific specialists, achieves breakthrough detection of six rare pathologies where all baselines score zero F1 while maintaining superior overall performance.
